settings.heading: Who is Orenda Women's® for?
settings.row_content:
Orenda Women's® was formulated specifically for women who want a daily multivitamin that goes meaningfully beyond a standard formula, one that accounts for the specific nutritional needs and hormonal considerations that matter most during the midlife years and beyond.

The formula is particularly well suited for women who want the complete spectrum of vitamin E — all eight forms, four tocopherols and four tocotrienols — rather than the single alpha-tocopherol found in most standard women's multivitamins,* those looking for BioFolate® methylated folate — more bioavailable than standard folic acid and the form the body uses most readily* — alongside CoQ10 for cellular energy support,* women who want the O-Harmony herbal blend, an exclusive combination of Dong Quai, Black Cohosh, Chaste Tree, Red Raspberry, Evening Primrose Oil, and Deodorized Garlic, botanicals with established research profiles for women's hormonal health and midlife wellness support,* and those who want advanced antioxidant support from Alpha Lipoic Acid, Grape Seed Extract, and Resveratrol alongside a complete vitamin and mineral profile.*

Orenda Women's® is not a hormone replacement product and is not intended to diagnose or treat any condition. It is a clean, purposeful daily multivitamin designed for women who want their supplement to reflect where they actually are in life, not a generic formula designed for women in general.

Three tablets daily. Non-GMO, gluten-free, no artificial colors or preservatives. Manufactured in a USA GMP-certified facility.

settings.heading: Why does Orenda Women's® use BioFolate® methylated folate instead of folic acid?
settings.row_content:
Most daily multivitamins use folic acid, the synthetic form of folate that has been the standard in supplements for decades. Folic acid works for many people, but for a meaningful portion of the population it presents a bioavailability challenge. The body needs to convert folic acid into its active form before it can be used, and for those with certain common genetic variations this conversion process is less efficient than it should be.*

BioFolate® is the methylated form of folate, already in the active state the body uses directly, without requiring conversion.* This makes it more bioavailable and more readily utilized than standard folic acid for a broader range of people.* It is the form increasingly recommended by health practitioners who work with patients on nutritional optimization, methylation support, and overall wellness.

For Orenda Women's®, the decision to use BioFolate® rather than standard folic acid reflects the same formulation philosophy behind every ingredient in the formula, choosing the form that the body can actually use rather than the form that is simply most common or least expensive. It is one of the details that separates a purposeful women's multivitamin from a standard one.

settings.heading: Why does Orenda Women's® use Methylcobalamin instead of standard vitamin B-12?
settings.row_content:
Most daily multivitamins use cyanocobalamin, the synthetic form of vitamin B-12 that has been the standard in supplements for decades. Cyanocobalamin works for many people, but it must be converted by the body before it can be used in its active form. For some people, this conversion process is less efficient than it should be,* which means the B-12 in their supplement may not be delivering its full potential benefit.

Methylcobalamin is the active form of vitamin B-12, already in the state the body uses directly, without requiring conversion.* This makes it more bioavailable and more readily utilized than standard cyanocobalamin for a broader range of people.* It is the form increasingly recommended by health practitioners who work with patients on nutritional optimization, energy metabolism support, and overall neurological wellness.

For Orenda Women's®, the decision to use Methylcobalamin rather than standard cyanocobalamin reflects the same formulation philosophy behind BioFolate® methylated folate, choosing the active form the body can actually use rather than the form that is simply most common or least expensive. Together, Methylcobalamin and BioFolate® represent a meaningful upgrade in the B-vitamin profile of Orenda Women's® that most standard multivitamins simply don't provide.

settings.heading: What are the benefits of CoQ10 in Orenda Women's®?
settings.row_content:
Coenzyme Q10 — commonly known as CoQ10 — is a naturally occurring compound the body produces and uses in virtually every cell. Its primary role is supporting the production of adenosine triphosphate, or ATP, the molecule that powers cellular energy metabolism.* CoQ10 is particularly concentrated in tissues with high energy demands, making it one of the more foundational compounds in the body's natural energy production processes.*

Research on CoQ10 is extensive and spans several decades. Studies support its role in cellular energy production,* cardiovascular function,* and antioxidant defense against oxidative stress.* CoQ10 levels naturally change over time, which is one of the reasons it has become an increasingly relevant addition to daily nutritional support.

In Orenda Women's®, CoQ10 sits alongside all eight forms of vitamin E and BioFolate® methylated folate, ingredients that share a common thread. Each was chosen because it represents a meaningful upgrade over what most standard women's multivitamins provide. CoQ10 is rarely included in standard multivitamin formulas at meaningful levels, which is one of the ways Orenda Women's® distinguishes itself from a basic daily supplement.*

settings.heading: Why does Orenda Women's® include all eight forms of vitamin E?
settings.row_content:
Most supplements deliver vitamin E as alpha-tocopherol alone, a single form of a nutrient that actually exists in eight naturally occurring forms. Orenda Women's® includes all eight: alpha-tocopherol, beta-tocopherol, gamma-tocopherol, and delta-tocopherol from the tocopherol family, and alpha-tocotrienol, beta-tocotrienol, gamma-tocotrienol, and delta-tocotrienol from the tocotrienol family.*

Each form has a distinct biological role. Tocopherols are the most studied and widely recognized forms of vitamin E, with alpha-tocopherol being the most common in supplements. Tocotrienols are less commonly included but have their own well-documented research profile, particularly around antioxidant defense and cellular health.* Together the eight forms work across a broader range of biological functions than any single form can address alone,* which is why the complete spectrum delivers meaningfully more comprehensive antioxidant support than the single-form approach found in most standard multivitamins.*

For Orenda Women's®, including all eight forms of vitamin E reflects the same formulation philosophy behind every ingredient in the formula, choosing completeness and specificity over the simplest or most common option. It is one of the details that makes Orenda Women's® a genuinely different daily multivitamin for women who want more than the basics.*

settings.heading: What are the Mixed Carotenoids in Orenda Women's®?
settings.row_content:
Most multivitamins include beta-carotene as their sole carotenoid, a single compound from a family of nutrients that actually exists in hundreds of naturally occurring forms. Orenda Women's® includes five distinct carotenoids: Alpha Carotene, Lutein, Lycopene, Zeaxanthin, and Astaxanthin, each with its own established research profile and distinct biological role.*

Alpha Carotene is a carotenoid found naturally in orange and yellow fruits and vegetables, with research supporting its role in antioxidant defense and overall cellular health.*

Lutein is one of the most researched carotenoids, with an established body of evidence supporting its role in eye health and protection against oxidative stress in the visual system.*

Lycopene is a well-studied carotenoid found naturally in tomatoes and other red fruits, with research supporting its role in antioxidant defense and cardiovascular wellness.*

Zeaxanthin works alongside Lutein in supporting eye health and visual function, and is increasingly recognized as one of the more important carotenoids for long-term ocular wellness.*

Astaxanthin is one of the most studied naturally occurring antioxidant carotenoids, with a growing body of research supporting its role in antioxidant defense, skin health, and overall cellular resilience.*

Together, these five carotenoids provide a broader spectrum of antioxidant coverage than beta-carotene alone can deliver,* reflecting the same formulation philosophy behind every ingredient in Orenda Women's®, choosing completeness and specificity over the most common or least expensive option.

settings.heading: What are the benefits of Alpha Lipoic Acid in Orenda Women's®?
settings.row_content:
Alpha Lipoic Acid — commonly known as ALA — is a naturally occurring antioxidant compound that the body produces and uses in cellular energy metabolism.* What makes it particularly distinctive is its dual solubility, unlike most antioxidants, which are either water-soluble or fat-soluble. Alpha Lipoic Acid functions in both environments,* allowing it to support antioxidant defense across a broader range of cellular contexts than most single antioxidants can address.*

Research on Alpha Lipoic Acid spans several decades and supports its role in antioxidant defense against oxidative stress,* healthy glucose metabolism,* and the regeneration of other antioxidants, including vitamins C and E.* This last point is particularly relevant in a formula that already includes all eight forms of vitamin E, ALA supports the body's ability to maintain and recycle the antioxidant activity those forms provide.*

In Orenda Women's®, Alpha Lipoic Acid sits alongside a comprehensive antioxidant complex that includes Grape Seed Extract, Resveratrol, N-Acetyl-L-Cysteine, and five named carotenoids. Each was chosen because it contributes something distinct to the formula's overall antioxidant coverage. ALA's dual solubility and its role in antioxidant recycling make it one of the more foundational compounds in that complex.*

settings.heading: What are the benefits of N-Acetyl-L-Cysteine in Orenda Women's®?
settings.row_content:
N-Acetyl-L-Cysteine — commonly known as NAC — is a naturally occurring compound and a precursor to glutathione, one of the body's most important internally produced antioxidants.* While glutathione is produced naturally by the body, consistent daily nutritional support for its production is one of the more meaningful things a comprehensive supplement formula can provide.* NAC is one of the most researched compounds for supporting the body's natural glutathione synthesis.*

Research on NAC spans several decades and supports its role in antioxidant defense against oxidative stress,* respiratory wellness,* and overall cellular health.* Its role as a glutathione precursor is what distinguishes it from most other antioxidant ingredients, rather than providing antioxidant activity directly, it supports the body's own internal antioxidant production system.*

In Orenda Women's®, NAC sits alongside Alpha Lipoic Acid, Grape Seed Extract, Resveratrol, and five named carotenoids, a comprehensive antioxidant complex where each ingredient contributes something distinct. NAC's role as a glutathione precursor adds a dimension of antioxidant support that none of the other ingredients in the complex provide,* making it one of the more purposeful additions to a daily women's multivitamin.

Including NAC in a daily multivitamin is genuinely uncommon. It reflects the same formulation philosophy behind every ingredient in Orenda Women's®, choosing completeness and specificity over the most common or least expensive option.

settings.heading: What is the O-Harmony Blend in Orenda Women's®?
settings.row_content:
The O-Harmony™ Blend is an exclusive botanical combination developed specifically for Orenda Women's®, nine botanicals chosen for their established research profiles in women's health and midlife wellness support.*

Dong Quai (Angelica sinensis) has a long history of use in traditional wellness systems for women's health, with research suggesting it supports hormonal balance and daily well-being.*

Red Raspberry (leaf) has a long history of use in women's wellness traditions, supporting overall reproductive health and daily well-being.*

Black Cohosh is one of the most studied botanicals for women's health, with an established body of research supporting its role in hormonal balance and midlife wellness.*

Chaste Tree (Vitex agnus-castus) has been used traditionally to support hormonal balance and is increasingly recognized in modern research for its role in women's wellness.*

Saw Palmetto has a long history of use in traditional wellness systems and is included in the O-Harmony™ Blend as part of a comprehensive daily botanical foundation for women.*

Panax Ginseng is one of the most researched adaptogenic botanicals, supporting natural energy, cognitive function, and the body's response to everyday stress.*

Deodorized Garlic provides cardiovascular and antioxidant support in a form that's comfortable for daily use.*

Evening Primrose Oil is a natural source of gamma-linolenic acid — a beneficial omega-6 fatty acid — supporting hormonal balance and daily wellness as part of a complete women's formula.*

Ginger has a well-established research profile for digestive comfort and natural inflammatory response support,* rounding out a formula designed to work across multiple areas of women's daily wellness.

Together, these nine botanicals complement the vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants in Orenda Women's®, a formula built to address what matters most to women navigating midlife and beyond.*

settings.heading: Should I take Orenda Women's® if I am on medication?
settings.row_content: Orenda Women's® was formulated with careful attention to safety. That said, if you are currently under medical care or taking any medications, we recommend consulting with your healthcare provider before adding any new supplement to your routine. Your healthcare provider understands your full health picture and is the right person to make that call with you.
